description: This file is a server-side module for a SvelteKit application managing invoice products. It handles data fetching, filtering, pagination, and CRUD operations for products through API requests to a Django backend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Server load function that fetches and processes a list of products from the backend API based on URL parameters, handles pagination, filtering, and transforms data for frontend use.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new product by processing form data and sending a POST request to the backend API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing product identified by productId, sending a PUT request to the backend API.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a product identified by productId via a DELETE request to the backend API.
